name: Unexpected Rain
summary: A sudden rainstorm disrupts movement, changes social patterns, and can create shelter-based conversations.

name: Teacher Absence
summary: A teacher does not arrive, leaving students with extra free time and a rush of social activity.

name: Power Outage
summary: A short power cut changes the tone of the day, especially in the library or hostel, where the mood becomes quieter and more tense.

name: Surprise Test
summary: A teacher unexpectedly administers a quiz or short test, shifting the mood immediately.

name: Sudden Storm and Traffic Crunch
summary: A traffic delay or weather issue creates social pressure for commuters, especially near the gate and bus stop.
